resources.string: This channel is used by caffeine service to show its notification
Caffeine keeps your screen awake with an invisible overlay. This permission is required — without it the app can\'t work.
Allow notifications so Caffeine can show an ongoing notification while it keeps the screen on. The service still runs without it, but you won\'t see or be able to stop it from the status bar.

Keep Caffeine running reliably in the background and after a reboot. Open the app settings and allow background activity — choose \"Unrestricted\", or on some phones \"Allow background activity\" instead of \"Restrict\".
Add a Caffeine tile to your Quick Settings panel to toggle the screen-awake service with a single tap.
